title: An ok shelf suitable for medium to light weight items
text:
An ok shelf suitable for medium to light weight items. Overall not worth the cost in my opinion.

Positives: Shelf assembly is very straight forward. Once fully assembled, the frame seems pretty rigid. Included a little mallet for those who may not have one.

Negatives: the metal pieces are VERY flimsy. Even gently tapping them into place yielded bent pieces. Must be careful when assembling. Some pieces arrived bent on the ends, so I had to bend them back to get them to slot into the holes. One piece was bent sharply enough that the protective paint layer flaked off. It’s in the corner but still an annoyance. The shelves themselves are also quite thin. I’d find it very hard to believe two of them could hold 400 lbs as advertised, let alone one of them. Fortunately I’m not using it for heavy items. I would not trust this unit for very heavy items unless you were ok with warped shelves. Caster wheels have a short screw, which does not leave much room for height adjustment to level it out. Mine is a little wobbly.
